reference_model.label: Public-evidence M1 ipRGC reference model
reference_model.cell_type: M1 intrinsically photosensitive retinal ganglion cell
reference_model.assembly_rule: Every module retains its own specimen, preparation, measurement and inference boundary. A type-level join is never presented as a same-cell measurement.
reference_model.state: morphology and somatic electrophysiology attached; phototransduction and intracellular photosensitivity not yet attached

evidence_terms.direct_specimen: A measurement made on the named reconstructed cell.
evidence_terms.m1_cohort: A measurement or fit from independently sampled M1 cells.
evidence_terms.iprgc_family: Evidence from another ipRGC type or mixed ipRGC population.
evidence_terms.retinal_neurone: Evidence from another retinal neurone class.
evidence_terms.frontier: A demonstrated mechanism whose magnitude or role in an intact M1 ipRGC is unresolved.

modules.anchor_relation: The geometry defines the reference specimen, but no other attached module was measured in this same cell.

public_files.sanitisation: Removed a conversion-contact email address and contributor workstation path from the upstream header; all 3,758 geometry records are unchanged.

observed_or_preserved: 35 bifurcations and 72 branches reported by NeuroMorpho.Org
not_observed_or_not_preserved: complete dendritic integrity (repository rating: Dendrites Moderate)
modules.standardisation_warning: The 0.125 µm dendritic radius in the CNG SWC is a fixed placeholder. NeuroMorpho.Org marks the reconstruction as No Diameter; it must not be treated as measured calibre.

sources.citation: Goetz J et al. (2022), Unified classification of mouse retinal ganglion cells using function, morphology, and gene expression, Cell Reports 40:111040
Schwartz G (2022), Traced Retinal Ganglion Cells – RGCtypes.org, Mendeley Data v1

modules.anchor_relation: Independent M1 cohorts; not the reconstructed 070320Ac10 specimen.

experimental_basis.notes: The sodium-current cell had most dendrites removed to improve space clamp. The published fit represents a class-level local optimum and the paper reports substantial within-type variability.

sources.citation: Stinchcombe AR et al. (2021), M1-Type, but Not M4-Type, Melanopsin Ganglion Cells Are Physiologically Tuned to the Central Circadian Clock, Frontiers in Neuroscience 15:652996

sources.license: No licence declared in the GitHub mirror as accessed 2026-09-15
sources.reuse_note: The upstream MATLAB file is not redistributed here. The JavaScript module is a new implementation of the published equations and numerical parameter values.

attachment_requirements: select a kinetic model with stimulus units and adaptation state
declare whether photocurrent is somatic or distributed
keep rod/cone synaptic drive separate from melanopsin drive
validate irradiance-to-current and current-to-spike joins independently
represent wavelength-dependent absorption rather than reuse the melanopsin 480 nm control
locate each chromophore and optical path by compartment
separate signalling, metabolic modulation, heating and photodamage hypotheses
attach only mechanisms with a measurable state variable and falsifiable coupling to the M1 model

joins.valid_claim: A public M1 morphology and a public M1 somatic conductance model can coexist in one inspectable reference assembly.
joins.invalid_claim: The displayed conductances were measured in 070320Ac10 or are distributed over its arbor.

morphology_candidate_audit.selection_reason: Most extensive of the three public M1 reconstructions in the archive and preserves a soma.
